chapters_covered.chapter_title: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume

mathematical_vocabulary.definition: A declarative statement that is unambiguously either true or false.
A conditional statement formed by interchanging the hypothesis and conclusion of an implication.
A conditional statement formed by negating and swapping the hypothesis and conclusion (~Q -> ~P).
A specific instance that refutes a universal mathematical statement.
An average computed by weighting individual group values by their respective sample sizes or relative importance.
A multi-category bar chart where all bars are scaled to 100% to compare relative percentage distributions.
A finite, ordered, unambiguous step-by-step procedure for solving a problem.
An arithmetic operation (m mod n) that yields the integer remainder when m is divided by n.
The largest positive integer that divides two or more given integers without a remainder.
The segment joining midpoints of two triangle sides is parallel to the third side and half its length.
The intersection point of three medians of a triangle, dividing each median in a 2:1 ratio.
The parallelogram formed by connecting the adjacent side midpoints of any quadrilateral.
An algebraic equation of form ax + by + c = 0 representing a straight line on the Cartesian plane.
The measure of line steepness defined as vertical change divided by horizontal change (rise over run).
The distance from the apex of a right circular cone to any point on its circular base boundary.

definitions.name: Proposition
definitions.statement: A declarative sentence that holds a definitive truth value of either True or False, but not both.

definitions.name: Converse Statement
definitions.statement: For conditional proposition 'If P then Q', the converse is 'If Q then P'.

definitions.name: Contrapositive Statement
definitions.statement: For conditional proposition 'If P then Q', the contrapositive is 'If not Q then not P'.

definitions.name: Counterexample
definitions.statement: An explicit mathematical case that satisfies premise P but violates conclusion Q, proving 'If P then Q' false.

definitions.name: Weighted Arithmetic Mean
definitions.statement: x_bar = sum(w_i * x_i) / sum(w_i), where w_i represent sample weights and x_i represent values.

definitions.name: Algorithm
definitions.statement: A deterministic sequence of finite, unambiguous computational instructions.

definitions.name: Modulo Operator (m mod n)
definitions.statement: The unique integer remainder r such that m = q * n + r with 0 <= r < n.

definitions.name: Parallelogram
definitions.statement: A planar four-sided polygon (quadrilateral) with both pairs of opposite sides parallel.

definitions.name: Centroid G
definitions.statement: The concurrent point of intersection of a triangle's three medians, dividing medians in ratio 2:1.

definitions.name: Slope m
definitions.statement: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1), measuring the directional steepness of a straight line.

definitions.name: Curved Surface Area (CSA)
definitions.statement: The outer surface area of a 3D solid excluding its flat top and bottom bases.

definitions.name: Total Surface Area (TSA)
definitions.statement: The complete surface area of a 3D solid including all curved and flat boundary faces.

concepts.title: Logical Independence of Converses
concepts.description: A proposition P -> Q and its converse Q -> P are logically distinct. The truth of one does not imply the truth of the other.

concepts.title: Logical Equivalence of Contrapositives
concepts.description: A conditional statement P -> Q and its contrapositive ~Q -> ~P always share identical truth values in all interpretations.

concepts.title: Disproof by Single Counterexample
concepts.description: While confirming examples cannot prove a universal assertion, a single valid counterexample conclusively disproves it.

concepts.title: Fallacy of Unweighted Group Averages
concepts.description: Averaging group percentages directly without multiplying by sample counts produces errors when group sizes differ.

concepts.title: Algorithmic Efficiency Jump
concepts.description: Replacing Euclidean subtraction loops with Āryabhaṭa remainder division improves GCD complexity from linear O(N) to logarithmic O(log N).

concepts.title: Varignon Midpoint Invariance
concepts.description: Connecting midpoints of adjacent sides of ANY quadrilateral (convex, non-convex, or irregular) always forms a parallelogram.

concepts.title: Universal 2D Plane Tessellation
concepts.description: Because interior angles of any quadrilateral sum to 360 degrees, four identical quadrilateral tiles rotated around midpoints tile a plane seamlessly.

concepts.title: Linear Equation Solution Sets
concepts.description: A linear equation ax + by + c = 0 has infinitely many ordered pair solutions (x, y) forming a continuous straight line graph.

concepts.title: Archimedean Volume Ratio (1:2:3)
concepts.description: A cone, sphere, and cylinder sharing base radius r and height h = 2r have volumes in the exact integer ratio 1 : 2 : 3.

concepts.title: Square-Cube Scaling Law
concepts.description: Scaling linear dimensions of a solid by factor k scales surface area by k^2 and volume/mass by k^3.

properties.statement: Truth of P -> Q does not guarantee truth of Q -> P.
Equivalence P <-> Q holds if and only if both P -> Q and Q -> P are true.
Total mass and component mass are strictly conserved when combining distinct alloy batches or solutions.
For any positive integers m and n, 0 <= (m mod n) < n.
If d divides m and n, then d divides (m - n) and (m mod n).
For any positive integers m and n, m * n = gcd(m, n) * lcm(m, n).
The diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other if and only if the quadrilateral is a parallelogram.
Rectangle diagonals are equal; Rhombus diagonals are perpendicular at 90 degrees; Square diagonals are both equal and perpendicular.
Parallel lines have equal slopes (m1 = m2); Perpendicular lines have negative reciprocal slopes (m1 * m2 = -1).
Melting and recasting a solid figure into different shapes preserves total internal volume.

rules.rule_statement: If a triangle has side lengths satisfying a^2 + b^2 = c^2, then the angle opposite side c is a right angle (90 deg).
Always multiply subgroup means by subgroup counts before dividing by the sum of subgroup counts.
gcd(m, n) = gcd(n, m mod n) for positive integers m >= n.
In triangle ABC with midpoints D on AB and E on AC: DE || BC and DE = 0.5 * BC.

For system a1*x + b1*y + c1 = 0 and a2*x + b2*y + c2 = 0: 1. Unique solution if a1/a2 != b1/b2; 2. Parallel/No solution if a1/a2 = b1/b2 != c1/c2; 3. Coincident/Infinite solutions if a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2.
Distance from point (x0, y0) to line ax + by + c = 0 is d = |a*x0 + b*y0 + c| / sqrt(a^2 + b^2).

formulas.expression: m = q * n + r  where r = m mod n and 0 <= r < n
TSA = 2(lw + wh + lh),  Volume = l * w * h
Slant Height l = sqrt(r^2 + h^2),  CSA = pi*r*l,  TSA = pi*r*(r + l),  Volume = (1/3)*pi*r^2*h

steps: Identify universal statement 'For all x, P(x) implies Q(x)'.
Search for a specific candidate x0 that satisfies hypothesis P(x0).
Verify whether conclusion Q(x0) fails.
If Q(x0) is false, cite x0 as a valid counterexample disproving the universal statement.
Identify individual subgroup averages x1, x2, ..., xn.
Identify respective subgroup counts or weight factors w1, w2, ..., wn.
Multiply each subgroup average by its weight to find product terms w_i * x_i.
Sum all product terms to find total combined sum.
Sum all weight factors to find total weight sum(w_i).
Divide total product sum by total weight sum to obtain weighted mean x_bar.
Assign m = max(a, b) and n = min(a, b).
Compute integer remainder r = m mod n.
If r == 0, output n as the Greatest Common Divisor and terminate.
If r > 0, set m = n and n = r, then repeat step 2.
Express equations in general form a1*x + b1*y + c1 = 0 and a2*x + b2*y + c2 = 0.
Calculate x-intercept (set y=0) and y-intercept (set x=0) for both lines.
Plot intercept coordinates on Cartesian grid and draw continuous straight lines.
Identify coordinate intersection point (x, y) as the unique solution.
Calculate volume of initial solid V_initial using appropriate mensuration formula.
Calculate volume of single recast solid V_single.
Equate V_initial = N * V_single assuming no material loss.
Solve for unknown count N = V_initial / V_single.

relationships.description: Truth of implication P -> Q does not guarantee truth of converse Q -> P.
Statement P -> Q and contrapositive ~Q -> ~P always share identical truth values.
Euclidean subtraction is linear O(N), while Āryabhaṭa remainder division is logarithmic O(log N).
Equal outer diagonals yield a Varignon Rhombus; Perpendicular outer diagonals yield a Varignon Rectangle.
Ratio inequality a1/a2 != b1/b2 corresponds to intersecting lines with 1 unique solution.
For height h = 2r, volumes obey V_cone : V_sphere : V_cylinder = 1 : 2 : 3.

units_measurements.measurement_type: Plane Angle (360° total vertex angle sum)

patterns.description: Implications have independent converse truth values unless bi-conditional equivalence holds.
Internal component percentages in every bar sum strictly to 100% across all groups.
Division remainders decrease monotonically until reaching zero in finite steps.
Consecutive Fibonacci numbers yield quotients of 1 at every step, creating maximum GCD search steps.
Area of Varignon midpoint parallelogram is always exactly half the area of the outer quadrilateral.
Straight line ax + by = c cuts X-axis at (c/a, 0) and Y-axis at (0, c/b).
Linear length scales by k, surface area scales by k^2, and volume scales by k^3.

problem_solving_strategies.description: To disprove a general statement, focus search on boundary or edge cases that satisfy hypothesis P but violate conclusion Q.
Convert group percentages to total count products before combining averages across unequal sample sizes.
Replace iterative subtraction loops with modulo division steps to minimize algorithmic execution time.
Draw diagonals across quadrilaterals to create auxiliary triangles for applying the Midpoint Theorem.
Evaluate x-intercept (y=0) and y-intercept (x=0) to quickly plot linear equations on Cartesian coordinates.
Equate total initial solid volume to total recast volume to solve for missing dimensions or item counts.
Estimate large-scale physical volumes by modeling them as uniform layers (Thickness = Total Volume / Surface Area).
